The following events occurred in '''998 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]] begins learning [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith sorcery]] that was extracted from [[Freedon Nadd's holocron]] by [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]].<ref name="rot">''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]'' - Chapter 13 states Darth Zannah was 12 when she began learning Sith sorcery. Since she was 10 when Darth Bane found her in 1,000 BBY, this would make the year 998 BBY when she was 12.</ref>
